filler_lines: इस टॉपिक के पूरे नोट्स चाहिए? नोट्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, नोट्स ज़रूर ले लीजिए।
प्रैक्टिस के लिए मॉक टेस्ट चाहिए? मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, मॉक्स ज़रूर ले लीजिए।
नोट्स और मॉक्स, दोनों के लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में मौजूद हैं, उन्हें लेना मत भूलिए।
रिवीज़न के लिए नोट्स लीजिए, और परीक्षा जैसी प्रैक्टिस के लिए मॉक्स लीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
जो प्रश्न अभी छूट गए, उनके नोट्स डिस्क्रिप्शन में दिए लिंक से ले लीजिए।
हर हफ्ते मॉक टेस्ट हल करने से स्कोर बढ़ता है, मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
अगर अब तक के प्रश्न सही रहे, तो मॉक्स लेकर अपना स्तर और परखिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
नोट्स लेना न भूलें, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, और अपने दोस्तों को भी बताइए।
कंप्यूटर के प्रश्नों पर पकड़ मज़बूत करनी है? तो नोट्स लीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
वीडियो पसंद आ रहा है तो लाइक कीजिए, और नोट्स व मॉक्स के लिए डिस्क्रिप्शन का लिंक खोलिए।
मॉक टेस्ट हल करने की आदत डालिए, मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, अभी ले लीजिए।
चैनल Target1st को सब्सक्राइब कीजिए, नोट्स और मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
ये पॉइंट नोट कर लीजिए, और पूरे नोट्स के लिए डिस्क्रिप्शन में दिया लिंक देखिए।
सिर्फ़ वीडियो देखना काफ़ी नहीं, मॉक्स भी हल कीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
नोट्स ले लो, मॉक्स ले लो, दोनों के लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में हैं, और तैयारी में जुट जाओ।

questions.q: Who is known as the father of the World Wide Web?
points: Tim Berners-Lee invented the WWW in 1989
Vint Cerf is called a father of the Internet
Charles Babbage is the father of the computer

questions.q: Which was the earliest network that led to the Internet?
points: ARPANET was developed by the US Department of Defense

questions.q: What is an ISP?
options: A company that provides Internet access
points: It connects users to the Internet

questions.q: Which of the following is a private network inside an organisation using Internet technology?
points: Intranet is accessible only to organisation members
The Internet is a public global network

questions.q: Which domain extension is used for government sites in India?
points: .gov.in is used by Indian government sites

questions.q: Which email field is used to send a copy visible to all recipients?
Which protocol retrieves email and keeps it on the server for multiple devices?
points: POP3 usually downloads and removes mail from the server

questions.q: What does the "@" symbol separate in an email address?
points: Left part is the user, right part is the mail server domain
Spaces are not allowed in an address

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a web server software?
points: A web server delivers web pages to browsers
Apache, Nginx and IIS are web servers
Browser is the client, server gives the page

questions.q: Which key combination reloads a web page ignoring the cache?
points: Ctrl + F5 forces a hard refresh

questions.q: Which shortcut opens a new tab in most browsers?
points: Ctrl + T opens a new tab
Ctrl + N opens a new window

questions.q: Which shortcut opens browsing history in Chrome?
What is phishing?
options: Fake messages that steal personal information
points: Phishing tricks users into sharing passwords or card details
It often uses fake emails and websites

questions.q: Which of the following is the safest password practice?
options: Use a long mix of letters, numbers and symbols
points: Strong passwords are long and unpredictable
Use different passwords for different accounts

questions.q: Which language is used to style web pages?
points: It controls colour, layout and fonts
HTML gives structure, CSS gives style

questions.q: Which HTML tag is the root element of a page?
points: <!DOCTYPE html> is a declaration, not a tag

questions.q: Which HTML tag defines the title shown in the browser tab?
points: It is also used by search engines
<h1> is a visible heading in the body

questions.q: Which HTML tag is used for the largest part of paragraph text?
points: Browsers add space before and after it

questions.q: Which tag creates a horizontal line?
Which HTML attribute sets the width of an image?
Which tag is used to define a table header cell?
points: <th> is bold and centred by default

questions.q: Which HTML tag embeds a video file?
points: It supports controls and autoplay attributes

questions.q: Which HTML5 tag defines the navigation links section?
points: <nav> marks a block of navigation links
<header> and <footer> are other HTML5 semantic tags
Semantic tags improve readability and SEO

questions.q: Which of the following is a valid HTML comment?
points: HTML comments start with <!-- and end with -->
They are not shown on the page

questions.q: Which input type creates a checkbox?
points: Checkbox lets the user pick several options
type="radio" allows only one choice in a group

questions.q: Which attribute makes a form field compulsory?
points: required stops form submission if empty

questions.q: Which CSS selector targets an element with id "main"?
points: An id should be unique on a page

questions.q: Which CSS property controls text size?
Which JavaScript keyword declares a variable?
points: var, let and const declare variables

questions.q: Which event occurs when a user clicks an HTML element?
points: onclick fires on a mouse click
onmouseover fires when the pointer moves over
onload fires when the page loads

questions.q: Which company created JavaScript?
points: Brendan Eich created JavaScript at Netscape in 1995
It is not the same as Java
It is the main language of DHTML scripting

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a part of DHTML?
points: It changes pages without reloading from the server
C++ is not part of it

questions.q: Which Excel feature keeps top rows visible while scrolling?
points: Freeze Panes is in the View tab
Split divides the window into parts

questions.q: Which Excel shortcut inserts the current date?
points: Ctrl + Shift + : enters the current time
Both enter fixed values, not formulas

questions.q: Which Excel function counts cells that meet a condition?
What does the Excel IF function do?
options: Tests a condition and returns one of two values

questions.q: Which Excel error appears when a formula divides by zero?
How many rows does a worksheet have in modern Excel?
points: It has 16,384 columns, up to column XFD

questions.q: Which Word feature shows changes made by reviewers?
points: Track Changes is in the Review tab
Changes can be accepted or rejected
Comments allow notes beside the text

questions.q: Which shortcut opens Find and Replace dialog in Word?
Which Word feature adds text at the top of every page?
points: Header repeats text at the top margin
Footer repeats text at the bottom

questions.q: Which shortcut selects the entire document in Word?
Which Word feature creates a list of headings with page numbers?
points: Table of Contents is in the References tab

questions.q: What is the default line spacing in recent MS Word versions?
points: New Word versions use 1.08 line spacing
Change it from the Paragraph group

questions.q: Which PowerPoint feature controls how one slide moves to the next?
points: Animations apply to objects on a slide

questions.q: Which PowerPoint view controls the common layout of all slides?
points: Slide Master sets fonts, colours and logos for all slides
Change it once to update the whole deck
Find it in the View tab

questions.q: Which key ends a slide show in PowerPoint?
points: Shift + F5 starts from the current slide

questions.q: Which Access object stores the data?
points: Tables hold records in rows and fields in columns
Queries retrieve data, forms enter data

questions.q: Which file format is best for sharing a read-only document that keeps layout?
points: PDF keeps layout the same on all devices

questions.q: Which of the following is a cloud storage service?
points: Cloud storage keeps files on remote servers
Dropbox and OneDrive are also cloud storage
Files can be reached from any device with Internet
